scope: Honor ODA AcDb:Template byte-count framing, decode supported non-empty descriptions with the source codepage, publish them through an optional DWG consumer callback, and retain strict refusal when DXF cannot represent them.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
authority.layout: Int16 description byte count; that many codepage-encoded bytes; UInt16 MEASUREMENT (0 or 1).

implementationReadiness.compatibilityDecision: Use ODA §22's signed byte-count framing across all six implemented reader revisions. For an exact, well-bounded non-empty byte-count profile, publish MEASUREMENT to tolerant consumers and warn so strict-complete DXF output refuses to discard the description. Retain the warning-only/no-measurement path for modern TU16-shaped data because LibreDWG 0.13.3 uses TU16 in its R2007+ T16 path, conflicting with ODA; do not guess the measurement offset without a producer-bound independent sample. Keep the narrow legacy modern one-unit UTF-16 NUL compatibility form.
implementationReadiness.implementation: The decoder bounds the signed 16-bit byte count against the logical section, requires MEASUREMENT to occupy exactly the final two logical bytes, validates its 0/1 domain, and distinguishes empty descriptions from non-empty byte strings. It copies description bytes only when a DWG callback consumer exists, decodes the ODA byte-count profile through the recognized source codepage, and delivers it through a new optional trailing DRW_Interface callback. If the bounded optional copy cannot allocate, the reader warns and still publishes the already-validated MEASUREMENT. Modern TU16-shaped profiles remain warning-only without a guessed measurement. Both non-empty profiles retain the existing strict-output warning because DXF has no corresponding field.
limitations: The modern TU16-shaped profile conflicts with ODA §22 and remains warning-only with no guessed MEASUREMENT until an eligible producer sample adjudicates it.

A local LibreDWG 0.13.3 writer/readback profile preserved a non-empty AC1024 description, but libdxfrw rejected that generated DWG at BAD_READ_FILE_HEADER before reaching AcDb:Template; this does not validate the libdxfrw parser against that profile.
DXF has no corresponding HEADER field, so Template descriptions cannot be preserved by strict DWG-to-DXF conversion.
No independently produced non-empty-description DWG or native template semantic evidence is available.

The optional-description allocation-failure branch is fail-tolerant in code but has no injected-allocation test; it preserves the separately validated MEASUREMENT and emits the same strict-output-blocking warning.

implementationReadiness.apiDecision: The callback is appended to DRW_Interface and defaults to no-op, preserving existing source subclasses; binary ABI compatibility remains part of the broader P8 gate.

coverage: All six implemented versions use the ODA byte-count boundary and expose the following measurement value for the bounded ODA profile.
The largest signed byte count is bounded and does not consume decompressed page padding.
Empty canonical descriptions and the established legacy modern UTF-16 NUL form remain accepted.
Malformed, truncated, out-of-range, and trailing-byte forms remain failures without partial header publication.
A well-framed modern non-empty ODA byte-count description emits TemplateDescriptionUnsupported and publishes MEASUREMENT for tolerant reading.
A modern TU16-shaped description remains tolerant, warns, and does not publish a guessed MEASUREMENT.
An AC1018 CP1252 description with a trailing NUL decodes to UTF-8 and reaches the optional consumer callback.
Non-ASCII description bytes with an unrecognized source codepage remain readable but are not published as potentially corrupted UTF-8.
Strict-complete output preserves the existing destination and refuses the unsupported description warning.
